question: Measure the capacity bound of the oracle-free direct INT8 prefill route (HIPENGINE_GGUF_INT8_PREFILL_DIRECT=1, flash kernel), including whether the model's full 262,144-token context fits.

memory_model.slope_decomposition: 16 full-attention layers x 2 (K,V) x 1 KiB int8 per layer per token, plus per-token/head fp32 scales and position metadata; weights are 16.25 GiB of the fixed cost (verified against the 196,608-point allocation census: full_attention_kv_cache 6,152 MiB, kv_scales 96.1 MiB, linear_attention_state 151.5 MiB, metadata_tables 96.1 MiB)
memory_model.note: The full 262,144 context cannot fit on a 24 GB card with this route; the card-bound ceiling is ~232-235K tokens.

protocol.tier2_full_prompt_points: scripts/qwen35_gguf_bench.py --model <27B Q4_K_M> --decode-tokens 8 --persistent-session --force-bulk-prefill --kv-storage int8_per_token_head --kv-scale-dtype fp32 --warmup-runs 0 --measured-runs 1, env HIPENGINE_GGUF_INT8_KV_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_LONG=1, HIPENGINE_GGUF_INT8_KV_BF16_FULL_LAYERS=none, HIPENGINE_GGUF_INT8_PREFILL_DIRECT=1, HIPENGINE_GGUF_INT8_PREFILL_KERNEL=flash. A pass requires the full synthetic repeated-token prefill plus eight timed decode transitions with finite final logits. These prove completion/stability and tok/s at depth.
protocol.tier1_allocation_probe_points: scripts/gguf_capacity_probe.py --max-sequence-length N with the same route envs (short prompt, finite logits, tracked peak). These prove the memory envelope only - see benchmarks/HARNESSES.md "Capacity testing" for why allocation validity does not need the full prompt.
protocol.lesson: The 163,840/196,608 tier-2 points each cost ~50-70 minutes of prefill while their allocation decision was made in the first ~3 minutes; the 262,144 OOM and the 229,376/232,448/235,520 bracket were answered by tier-1 probes in ~3 minutes each.

262144.detail: hipMalloc fails inside _FullStackScratch.allocate at the full-capacity value_cache; the fixed-cost resident footprint (weights + 262,144-position per-layer INT8 K/V + scales + per-position arrays, predicted ~24.8 GiB) exceeds the 23.98 GiB card before any prefill work. The model's full context length does not fit on 24 GB on this route.

quality_caveat: The direct route failed the numerics gate (mean row-KL 0.215 vs BF16 at 4,096 tokens where the oracle route measures 0.003; see results/2026-09-09-rx7900xtx-gguf-int8-direct-prefill-gate.json). This capacity is an opt-in lever with that measured quality cost, not a default route.
